# INFECTION CONTROL

Minneapolis VAMC infection control policies and practices are designed to prevent infection and infectious diseases among patients, employees, visitors, families and friends. This section briefly summarizes key infection control practices.

---

---

During nights, weekends, and holidays, contact the on-call person for Infectious Diseases.
